audit.whatIsWrong: The whole 'full' layer is unedited template: Gwen is called 'he/his' in tldr, phases[0-3], breakdown.early/mid, itemization and loading, and the difficulty text says nothing Gwen-specific.
audit.why: Gwen is a scaling AP fighter whose lane is decided by one zone (Hallowed Mist, 22s at rank 1) and one scaling item (Nashor's Tooth). The content layer already knows this; the full layer never mentions either.
audit.corrected: Pronouns fixed and the full layer's stage text rebuilt around the 22s mist window and her Nashor's spike, matching the content layer's read.

audit.whatIsWrong: Gwen's ultimate never appears in the full layer ('Reassess his ultimate too') and the late-game spike attributed her scaling only to items.
audit.why: Needlework is 120/100/80 and casts up to three times, each cast applying A Thousand Cuts — it is a real level-6 and late-game spike alongside Nashor's Tooth.
audit.corrected: Needlework named at the level-6 phase; the late spike now separates her item scaling from her ult.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two hard errors. (a) The page repeatedly says Gwen is 'untargetable' inside Hallowed Mist and that your taunt and knockup 'whiff' — that is only true from outside. (b) It says 'the final hit of Snip Snip deals true damage'; the true damage is positional, not sequential. It also claims Hallowed Mist 'catches you mid-dash', which is not a thing the ability does.
audit.why: Riot's Hallowed Mist text: 'Gwen summons mist that protects her from enemies outside of it. She can only be targeted by enemies who enter the mist.' So Justice Punch into the mist and she is targetable — the mist is a reason to dash IN, not to back off, and that inverts the advice the page gave. Riot's Snip Snip! text: 'Gwen deals true damage to units in the center' — the centre of the cone, on each of the up-to-six snips, so standing off-centre is the mitigation.
audit.corrected: Mist rewritten as 'stand inside it and she is targetable again' across content and full; the true-damage line moved to the centre of the cone with 'fight from the edge' as the play; the 'catches you mid-dash' don't replaced with the real mistake (releasing the taunt from outside the mist).

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Track Hallowed Mist' appears eight times with no cooldown attached.
audit.why: Hallowed Mist is 22/21/20/19/18 against Justice Punch's 11/10/9/8/7 and Shield of Durand's 18/17/16/15/14 — at rank 1 the mist is the longest cooldown on either side of the lane, which is what makes 'trade when it is down' actionable.
audit.corrected: 22s written into the cooldown block, the do's line, Key Ability Interactions and the loading tip.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Oblivion Orb early — his healing fights your trade math' named no source, and nothing warned a tank Galio about health stacking.
audit.why: A Thousand Cuts deals bonus magic damage scaled to the target's health and heals Gwen off it — flagged as needs-antiheal in _missing-interactions.json. Raw HP on Galio makes her passive hit harder, so the resist/anti-heal side matters more than stacking health.
audit.corrected: Itemization now names A Thousand Cuts as the heal source and warns that health stacking feeds it.

audit.whatIsWrong: Skip 'n Slash's cooldown refund was never mentioned.
audit.why: Riot: 'If she hits an enemy during that time, this Ability's cooldown is partially refunded.' Her 13s dash is only 13s when she misses — so 'her E is down' is only true when she has not connected, which changes when you can commit.
audit.corrected: Written into the level-4-5 phase and the wants line as 'her dash refunds itself when it connects'.

edits.before: This is your window. From level 3 your W-taunt into E-knockup out-trades her snip poke because Shield of Durand is heavily amplified against her magic-based damage, and at 6 Hero's Entrance turns you into a map threat she can't answer — she's glued to lane farming toward Nashor's while you R into another lane, shield a teammate, and snowball. In lane, bait her E in, then release the taunt; the only thing that saves her is dropping W Hallowed Mist early to sit untargetable, so watch her mist cooldown and commit your combo when it's down. Never E into her while she's standing inside the mist — taunt and knockup both do nothing to an untargetable Gwen.
edits.after: This is your window. From level 3 your W-taunt into Justice Punch out-trades her snip poke because Shield of Durand is heavily amplified against her magic damage, and at 6 Hero's Entrance turns you into a map threat she can't answer — she's glued to lane farming toward Nashor's while you R into another lane, shield a teammate, and snowball. In lane, bait her Skip 'n Slash in, then release the taunt; her one out is Hallowed Mist, 22s at rank 1, and her dash refunds part of its own cooldown whenever it connects. Do not back off the mist — it only blocks enemies standing outside it, so punch into the cloud and she is targetable again from inside.

edits.before: This flips to her. Once Gwen finishes Nashor's Tooth and Riftmaker she out-scales you: her sustained snip DPS shreds you, the final hit of Snip Snip deals true damage that ignores the MR you stacked to be a sponge, and W Hallowed Mist lets her sit untargetable so your taunt and E whiff. Your shield reduces nothing against the true-damage portion. Don't try to 1v1 her late — your value is using R to start fights for your team and to peel, not dueling her in a side lane. Win the map on the lead you built from 3 through 6, because the longer it goes the more her items beat your tank plateau.
edits.after: This flips to her. Once Gwen finishes Nashor's Tooth and Riftmaker she out-scales you: her sustained snip DPS shreds you, the centre of Snip Snip! deals true damage that ignores the MR you stacked to be a sponge, and A Thousand Cuts scales off your health, so raw HP stacking only feeds her. Hallowed Mist blocks you only from outside, so punch in if you must fight — but better not to 1v1 her late at all. Your value is R to start fights for your team and taunt-peel for your carries, not duelling in a side lane. Win the map on the lead you built from 3 through 6.

notes: Two real errors killed here. (1) The page told the reader Gwen is untargetable in Hallowed Mist and that the taunt whiffs — Riot's text says she is only protected from enemies OUTSIDE the mist, so the correct play is the exact opposite of what was written: Justice Punch into the cloud and taunt her from inside. (2) 'The final hit of Snip Snip deals true damage' — the true damage is dealt to units in the CENTRE of the cone on each snip, so the mitigation is positional, not waiting out a sequence. Also fixed roughly a dozen 'he/his' references to Gwen across the full layer. LEVEL-CHART MISMATCH I could not fix inside the length rule: content win[] and full phases[].side both read Skill/Gwen/Gwen/Skill/Skill/Gwen/Gwen, while the prose at those same stages says Galio out-trades her from level 2 through first item, and the scratchpad packet's levelChart reads Skill/Galio/Galio/Galio/Galio/Galio/Gwen. On-disk win rate is 48.28% over 435 games, so a Gwen-leaning chart is defensible overall — but the mid-lane stages still disagree with their own why text. Flipping a side value ('Gwen', 4 chars, to 'Galio', 5) is a 25% length change the applier would reject, so I left every side alone and only made the prose non-contradictory where I touched it.
